subject: Technical acceptance pathway and POC kickoff - BlueFin Analytics
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Jared Kim <jared.kim@bluefin.ai>, aditya_rao@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Technical acceptance pathway and POC kickoff - BlueFin Analytics

Hi Jared — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth for the POC run: 

High-level goal:
- Validate Redwood inference end-to-end on BlueFin’s risk-scoring workload with a 48-hour 1k-record sample, target latency P95 < 350ms and token-cost within forecasted range.

Success criteria (original + measurable):
- Accuracy: generated summaries must match BlueFin-labeled baseline with >= 92% of key-entity coverage on our eval set (see tab "Acceptance" in attached).
- Latency: P95 server-side < 350ms for 512-token sequences under baseline load.
- Throughput: sustain 40 TPS peak for 10-minute burst window without errors.
- Data safety: no customer PII leaves BlueFin; keys stored in your KMS and we confirm audit log visibility.

POC timeline (proposed):
- Kickoff + env prep: week of Nov 30 (kickoff meeting 12/1)
- Data ingest & baseline runs: Dec 2–6
- Performance tuning & weekly check-ins: Dec 7–18 (2x/week short syncs)
- Final readout & decision: Dec 21 (30-min exec readout)

Ownership (internal / BlueFin):
- Monika (me) - overall POC lead / customer contact / readout presenter
- Aditya Rao - infra & escalation lead (resource commits, escalation path)
- Marcus Lin - performance tuning / model ops contact
- BlueFin: Jared (data readiness), Priya (security/compliance contact)

Immediate asks for kickoff:
1) Confirm kickoff attendee list and preferred time (we penciled 12/1 11am PT).
2) Share the production-like sample (1k rows) by COB 11/27 — see sample_data_checklist.csv attached for format.
3) Confirm KMS/HSM details and who on your side will sign data access form.

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (acceptance matrix), network_requirements.pdf, sample_data_checklist.csv

If that schedule looks good I’ll send calendar invites and a shared Drive folder for artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

—
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for engineering teams
From: Jared Kim <jared.kim@bluefin.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@bluefin.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Technical acceptance pathway and POC kickoff - BlueFin Analytics

Monica — thanks for the thorough recap. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Schedule: 12/1 11am PT works for Jared + Priya. I’ll add our ML infra lead (Samir) once I confirm his calendar.
- Data: We can deliver the 1k sample by 11/27. We’ll strip direct PII, but we need to confirm how Redwood will access the data (S3 access role vs. secure upload portal).
- Security: Priya will send the SOC + vendor questionnaire responses by EOD 11/25. She flagged the KMS/HSM flow as high priority.

Risk callouts:
- If KV cache persistence is required for the experiment, we’ll need clarification on retention windows (we try not to persist any derived artifacts beyond the run).
- Network: bluefin's infra has strict egress rules — we’ll share the network_requirements.pdf and work with your infra lead to open the required endpoints.

We’re aligned on the success criteria but want to add one business metric: the POC should show at least a 15% reduction in manual review volume on the sample workflow. If the technical acceptance meets your thresholds, we’ll evaluate that downstream.

Attaching: none (we'll upload the PII policy & data sample to the Drive link you shared after the call).

Jared Kim
Head of Data Science | BlueFin Analytics
jared.kim@bluefin.ai | +1 (617) 555-4410
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800

Looping in a couple of operational items from the Redwood side. Good recap, Monica. A few practical commitments from us so BlueFin can plan: 

- Resource commits: I’ll allocate a dedicated infra slot for Dec 2–9 for initial ingest and baseline runs. Marcus will be on-call for tuning during Dec 7–18.
- Weekly cadence: propose Tue/Thu 30-min standups at 10:30am PT starting Dec 7. We’ll keep agenda light: blockers, perf numbers, next actions.
- Escalation: If we hit a perf blocker that blocks acceptance we’ll escalate to me and then to Platform Eng (I’ll CC the relevant channel).

Technical ask for BlueFin: please confirm where we should pull the sample from (S3 bucket name + IAM role) vs secure upload. If S3, we need a temp read-only role with explicit object prefix access.

I’ll put together a one-page runbook for the kickoff (env variables, endpoints, who runs which job). Monica — if you can share the invite list I’ll draft the runbook and drop it in the Drive folder.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
